parts.title: Off to the Beach
parts.text: Nia, Carlos, and Ella went to the beach for a **picnic**. They walked over a tall sand **dune**. Ella laid out a big **towel** for the food. A cool **breeze** blew over the water, and the sun felt warm.

parts.title: Treasure Hunt
parts.text: Their feet got **sandy**. Carlos took his **bucket** down to the **shore** to look for treasure. He found a pink **seashell**. Nia found a smooth gray **pebble**. They put them in a pile to show Mom.

parts.title: Waves
parts.text: The **tide** came in, and a little wave began to **tickle** their toes. Ella laughed and splashed. Carlos tried not to **spill** his water.

parts.title: A Sweet Ending
parts.text: They ate their sandwiches and watched the waves. Then the sun went low. They packed up and went home with full hearts.
